s02327.summary: Hugo pulls up to the bail drive-thru to free his sleepwalking brother
Doug butts in over the intercom and sets bail at two thousand
Hugo only has eleven hundred and balks at leaving his father's watch
Marisol relents and sends Hugo the form to sign

s01443.summary: Grumblewick demands a raised toll and the travelers protest in unison
Elowen pays, Bramblekin needles the troll, and they are waved across

s01653.summary: Eldrin stalks the bone market announcing closing while Sylvette pockets a vial
Eldrin buys a jar of glowing powder from Gorrak
Thistle touches the forbidden tooth and sparks leap from her fingers
Sylvette tries to take the tooth from Thistle
Eldrin lets Thistle keep the tooth and reveals he saw Sylvette's theft
A vast winged shape passes overhead as the market hushes and hides

s01313.summary: Six crash survivors huddle on the ice as Park fights Kerr's bleeding
Okafor burns thirty years of legal briefs to feed the dying fire
A distant thrum; Beatriz fires the flare and waits as it returns
A rescue helicopter bursts over the trees and the survivors break down

s02147.summary: With the cake van wedged under an overpass, Jules assures Penelope all is fine
Bartek decides to deflate the tires while Jules invents a parade
Bartek lets out air, the cake sways, and Penelope demands answers
The van rolls free, the cake survives, and the horns erupt joyfully

s01453.summary: Arlo comes home from a bad party to a dark apartment and apologizes to a plant
The answering machine plays only his own cheerful greeting and silence
Arlo opens his smeared fortieth cake, lights the bent candle, and sits
A message from future me makes Arlo laugh until he cries and eat the cake

s01377.summary: Helen and Agnes examine a missing elderly patient who fell down the chute
Cecilia wakes confused about the day and her hens; Helen takes her hand
Cecilia locks onto both women and rises demanding her husband
The radiator bangs and Cecilia remembers her husband has been dead nine years
Agnes comforts her, Helen calls a gurney, and Cecilia pats her hand

s00087.summary: Naomi runs Paul's hyperbaric treatment as pressure holds at two atmospheres
Naomi tells Paul he crawled from his ascent and will remember tomorrow

s02394.summary: Julian argues by phone that the late petition used a slow clock
Julian explodes that an innocent man dies in six hours
Prentiss coldly advises him to use the time wisely and hangs up

s01007.summary: Aloysius leads visitors into the ruined planetarium where the stars were never switched off
Delphine powers up the old projector and light climbs the dome
Delphine sees the constellations are wrong, with an extra star
After a flash, Ezra stands entranced, saying the star whispers his name
Delphine kills the power; a hiss, then the camera clicks by itself

s01805.summary: The family sits in tense small talk as Marcellus prepares to leave
Ben stares at the orchard while Adelaide checks his ticket tenderly
Philippa wins Ben over to come to the bus stop and hugs Marcellus
Ben promises the trees will wait and Adelaide hands over the lunch pail
Marcellus lingers, takes his thermos, embraces Ben, and goes out the door
Adelaide ladles oatmeal and makes Ben eat anyway

s01139.summary: Henrik escapes into the generator trailer and startles a crying Naomi
They share the flask and admit doubts about the toast and wedding
Neither leaves, their fingers touch, and they lean in for a kiss
Gran Imelda and Dewey burst in and summon them to the photographs
They vow this isn't over and leave; Imelda swears Dewey to secrecy

s02060.summary: A masked man cracking the safe hides behind a curtain as someone enters
Genevieve calmly reveals she knows he is hiding and calls him out
Genevieve circles the thief, probing his accomplice and his purpose
He reveals he knows her diamonds are fake
They brawl over the painting, smashing glass and the cocktail cabinet
She tears off the mask to find Lucien, and both stand betrayed

s01967.summary: Ottilie sets out cups and quietly slides one to withdrawn Pavel
Yoshiro and Ottilie banter about running it again while they wait
Ottilie senses Pavel's grief from last year and brings him a cup
A lone runner appears and Pavel steps forward offering the cup

s01692.summary: Pre-party chaos in the conservatory as Solange stumbles into a fern
Lazarus appears and signals Solange, who stiffens while Arthur is fussed over
Solange and Arthur both ask for a moment and laugh awkwardly
Lazarus leaves an envelope; Solange opens it and goes pale

s01747.summary: Ysolde and Pavan assure Inspector Greaves they are ahead of schedule
Greaves shows them the filed log full of warnings, disproving their claims
Ysolde offers tea; Greaves says he knows what they haven't done
The turbines fail and Greaves politely holds the door with four minutes left

s02213.summary: Trapped in the stuck lift, Teddy and Bastien bicker about the time
Bastien's watch is frozen and he masks his unease
Moth says home is below the basement where those who stay are kept
Teddy reveals Moth is a ghost girl from a farm a century ago
The bulb pops and the lift descends as Moth hums in the dark
Teddy and Moth are gone; doors open on a corridor with Moth waving

s01703.summary: Crowe leads his disguised crew through the laundry with strict instructions
The slow lift arrives and they bluff past a bellhop and ride up
They creep past a sleeping guard and open the suite to the vault
The lights blaze and the security director draws on them; Crowe surrenders

s00114.summary: Elowen dances alone, then challenges Artemis that he never asked her to dance
Artemis confesses the still lake frightens him and she draws him into a waltz
Mirabel predicts Artemis will cry as he admits he couldn't stay
The record stops and Elowen presses him to say what he came for
Mirabel announces he wants Elowen back, and Artemis confirms it
Elowen slaps Artemis for eleven years of silence and sending a child
Artemis laughs helplessly as Leonid offers Elowen a drink she downs

s02119.summary: In a stalled gondola, Milos menaces Lena and reaches for her briefcase
Milos feigns calm while Lena watches his drumming fingers
Milos reveals his watch controls the car and gives her ten minutes
Lena offers him the case but Milos hesitates and does not take it

s02017.summary: Hildegard rehearses the accusation scene and Reginald's rubber dagger folds
During the break Hildegard realizes Reginald brought his own knife
They spot a real blade in his pocket and Hildegard calmly demands it

s01018.summary: Deep down, Alvaro's sonar picks up something enormous and breathing
Oxygen drops and the contact closes as Zhao orders them up
A glow rises below and the ballast valves freeze as they try to flee
A cathedral-sized eye fills the viewport, gazing curiously at them

s00265.summary: Ireneus decides to camp under the dead starship despite Holger's worry
Myrt's music makes the mushrooms glow and Grandmama teases Holger
Theo reads the glyphs: do not wake the garden, and the ground stirs
Vines descend and attack; the party fights them off and runs
They escape the convulsing garden and Grandmama asks to go home

s00050.summary: Dom asks about Celeste's mystery novel and makes her laugh
A pothole drops her book; Dom returns it and their fingers touch
At the rest stop they collide, introduce themselves, and discover both go to Chicago

s01131.summary: Roxanne finds that the resurfacer's leak is a trail of blood
The engine coughs alone and a frost-furred figure uncurls from beneath
Gus and Roxanne fight the Figure and are hurled against the wall
They scatter as the Figure patiently folds back under the machine

s00598.summary: Around the fire the travelers bicker about the river and the mule
Tolliver orders everyone to sleep booted; Celestine senses he felt something
Pearl spots a signaling lantern on the north ridge
They douse the fire and stay silent as the light blinks out

s01936.summary: Four people trapped in a dark silo hear something moving
Something drags on the ladder and Katya fights Imogen for the light
They realize it waits for a scream as the flashlight dies
